thought.text: Now let me pre-pull all the Docker images in the background (they're large, especially Keycloak):

reasoning_content: Next, pull the docker image. I'll either run it in the background with a script, or execute it sequentially with a sufficient timeout. Pulling the image might take a while (Keycloak is large, roughly 700MB or so). Let's run it in the background and monitor it.

action.command:
cd /workspace && (for img in pgvector/pgvector:pg16 temporalio/auto-setup:1.29.0 temporalio/admin-tools:1.29 temporalio/ui:2.44.1 minio/minio minio/mc nginx:1.27-alpine qdrant/qdrant:v1.17.1 quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.0 quay.io/oauth2-proxy/oauth2-proxy:v7.8.1 authzed/spicedb:v1.49.0; do echo "=== PULL $img"; docker pull "$img" >> /tmp/docker-pull.log 2>&1 && echo "OK $img" || echo "FAIL $img"; done; echo "ALL_PULLS_DONE") > /tmp/pull-status.log 2>&1 &
echo "docker pulls started in background"
